questions.stem: What lesson does the story show?
questions.explanation: The passage says: "While helping at a craft stall, I try to wrap a mug in a hurry. I pull the paper too hard, and a corner tears beside the handle. The stall owner shows me how to leave a little extra space around the mug. I learn from her method and practise on an empty box before trying again. This time, the paper folds neatly without pressing against the handle. The customer is happy to wait a moment for a safer parcel. By closing time, I understand why doing something carefully can save time later." This supports the answer: "Taking care can prevent problems and save later effort".
questions.parentExplanation: 对应原文：帮手工摊位做事时，我匆忙地包装一只杯子。 我用力拉纸，杯柄旁的一角撕破了。 摊主教我怎样在杯子周围多留一点空间。 我学习她的方法，先在空盒子上练习，再尝试。 这次，纸折得整齐，也没有紧压杯柄。 顾客愿意多等一会儿，以获得更稳妥的包装。 收摊时，我明白了认真做事为何能在之后节省时间。 因此正确选项为“Taking care can prevent problems and save later effort”。

questions.stem: Which title best fits the passage?
questions.explanation: The passage says: "My twin cousins arrive to help us prepare the community garden. They wear the same green jacket design, so I first confuse their names. Luca puts labels beside the new plants, while Niko carries small empty pots. Both are full of energy and keep finding useful little jobs to do. When I ask how to tell them apart, each shows me a different badge. Soon I remember the names and stop calling both cousins at once. We finish the labels together and share a quiet snack beside the newly cleared path." This supports the answer: "Learning Two Names While Working Together".
questions.parentExplanation: 对应原文：我的双胞胎表亲来帮我们整理社区花园。 他们穿着设计相同的绿外套，我起初混淆了名字。 卢卡给新植物放标签，尼科搬小空花盆。 他们都充满活力，不断寻找能做的小事。 我问怎么分辨他们时，他们各自给我看不同的徽章。 很快，我记住名字，不再一口气把两个人都叫来。 我们一起完成标签，在新清出的小路旁安静地吃点心。 因此正确选项为“Learning Two Names While Working Together”。
